title: Reduce long-session cold-open and live refresh cost
outcome: Chrome profiling on the production UI found a 430ms cold-open INP for a 3,549-message transcript, dominated by 368ms presentation delay and 136ms forced reflow. Routine live refreshes also transfer a 2.19MB decoded /api/state summary plus a 487KB decoded tail. Implement focused frontend changes that reduce cold transcript layout work and avoid redundant refresh work without weakening SSE revision recovery.
acceptance: Cold long-session open avoids the identified synchronous layout hotspot; routine live events do not trigger redundant overview/tail/state reads; composer behavior remains correct; targeted tests, TypeScript, Vitest, production build, and relevant Rust gates pass.
